1: """Principal marked one-loop kernels; pure exact algebra, no IO on import.
2: 
3: Fourier +i, covariant h. Reported kernels remove common 4*i*kappa*A0.
4: The mixed h*c effective vertex is -U P Q^-1 V before stripping phases.
5: Its h derivative gives a ghost insertion minus 1/4 a metric insertion.
6: """
7: from functools import lru_cache
8: import sympy as s
9: from metric_principal_vertices import eh_cubic_16k, clear_caches
10: from one_loop_scale_engine import q, ANGULAR_FACTOR, log_coefficient
11: 
12: LABELS=[(i,j) for i in range(4) for j in range(i,4)]
13: BASIS=[]
14: for i,j in LABELS:
15:     H=s.zeros(4); H[i,j]=H[j,i]=1; BASIS.append(H)
16: S=s.Matrix(10,10,lambda i,j:s.trace(BASIS[i]*BASIS[j])-s.trace(BASIS[i])*s.trace(BASIS[j])/2).inv()
17: QQ=s.Matrix(q)
18: MONS=[s.S.One]+list(q)+[x*x for x in q]+[q[i]*q[j] for i in range(4) for j in range(i+1,4)]
19: AXES=[s.eye(4)[:,i] for i in range(4)]
20: 
21: def gauge(p,v): return p*v.T+v*p.T
22: def lie(H,k,l,v): return v.dot(k)*H+l*(H*v).T+(H*v)*l.T
23: def bracket(p,v,r,w): return v.dot(r)*w-w.dot(p)*v
24: def U(T,H,k,l): return k*s.trace(T*H)+2*H*T*l
25: def V(H,k,l):
26:     r=k+l
27:     return s.Matrix(4,4,lambda nu,rho:s.expand(-(
28:         k[rho]*(H*r)[nu]+r.dot(l)*H[rho,nu]+l[nu]*(H*r)[rho]
29:         -r[nu]*k[rho]*s.trace(H)/2-r[nu]*(H*l)[rho])))
30: def R0(p,v):
31:     return -s.Rational(3,8)*p.dot(p)*gauge(p,v)+s.Rational(1,2)*p*p.T*p.dot(v)
32: def normalized_log(n,shifts):
33:     return s.cancel(log_coefficient(s.expand(n),[tuple(x) for x in shifts],[0]*len(shifts))/ANGULAR_FACTOR)
34: 
35: @lru_cache(None)
36: def cubic_coefficients(h_tuple,p_tuple):
37:     p=s.Matrix(p_tuple)
38:     def W(node):
39:         return s.Matrix(10,10,lambda j,k:eh_cubic_16k(
40:             h_tuple,tuple(p),tuple(BASIS[j]),tuple(-node),tuple(BASIS[k]),tuple(node-p)))
41:     zero=s.zeros(4,1);c=W(zero)
42:     plus=[W(e) for e in AXES]; minus=[W(-e) for e in AXES]
43:     cs=[c]+[(plus[i]-minus[i])/2 for i in range(4)]
44:     cs += [(plus[i]+minus[i])/2-c for i in range(4)]
45:     cs += [W(AXES[i]+AXES[j])-plus[i]-plus[j]+c for i in range(4) for j in range(i+1,4)]
46:     point=s.Matrix([2,-1,1,3]);interp=s.zeros(10)
47:     for mon,C in zip(MONS,cs):interp+=mon.subs(dict(zip(q,point)))*C
48:     assert interp==W(point),'Cubic interpolation failed off nodes'
49:     clear_caches()
50:     return tuple(cs)
51: 
52: def marked_numerators(T,H,p,r,v):
53:     """h*(T,-p-r), h(H,p), c(v,r); common source metric momentum q."""
54:     l=p+r-QQ;k=r-QQ
55:     us=s.Matrix(10,4,lambda i,m:s.expand(U(T,BASIS[i],QQ,l)[m]))
56:     right_g=[V(B,-QQ,r)*v for B in BASIS]
57:     insertion=V(H,p,k)
58:     ghost=s.expand(sum(S[i,j]*s.expand((us[i,:]*insertion*right_g[j])[0])
59:                        for i in range(10) for j in range(10) if S[i,j]))
60:     # q metric and q-p metric; their endpoint pairing is S_ij S_km.
61:     left=S*us
62:     right=S*s.Matrix(10,4,lambda m,a:s.expand((V(BASIS[m],p-QQ,r)*v)[a]))
63:     W=cubic_coefficients(tuple(H),tuple(p))
64:     metric=0
65:     for mon,C in zip(MONS,W):
66:         metric+=mon*sum(C[j,k]*s.expand(left[j,:].dot(right[k,:]))
67:                         for j in range(10) for k in range(10) if C[j,k])
68:     return s.expand(ghost),s.expand(metric)
69: 
70: def marked(T,H,p,r,v):
71:     ng,nm=marked_numerators(T,H,p,r,v)
72:     zero=s.zeros(4,1)
73:     g=normalized_log(ng,[zero,-r,-p-r])
74:     m=normalized_log(nm,[zero,-p,-p-r])
75:     return g-m/4,g,m,ng,nm

77: def ghost_triangle(Y,v,w,p,r):
78:     k=QQ+p;l=r-QQ
79:     a=[V(H,QQ,p)*v for H in BASIS]
80:     b=[V(H,-QQ,r)*w for H in BASIS]
81:     n=s.expand(sum(S[i,j]*(l.dot(a[i])*Y.dot(b[j])-Y.dot(a[i])*k.dot(b[j]))
82:                    for i in range(10) for j in range(10) if S[i,j]))
83:     return normalized_log(n,[s.zeros(4,1),p,-r])
84: 
85: def simplex_log(n,shift1,shift2):
86:     """Independent Feynman-simplex UV coefficient for three massless factors."""
87:     x,y=s.symbols('x y');shift=x*shift1+y*shift2
88:     expr=s.expand(n.subs({q[i]:q[i]-shift[i] for i in range(4)},simultaneous=True))
89:     delta=x*shift1.dot(shift1)+y*shift2.dot(shift2)-shift.dot(shift);out=0
90:     for exps,c in s.Poly(expr,*q).terms():
91:         if any(a%2 for a in exps):continue
92:         a=sum(exps)//2
93:         if a<1:continue
94:         avg=s.prod(s.gamma(s.Rational(1,2)+v//2)/s.gamma(s.Rational(1,2)) for v in exps)/s.gamma(2+a)
95:         out+=2*c*avg*(-1)**(a-1)*s.binomial(a+1,2)*delta**(a-1)
96:     return s.integrate(s.integrate(s.expand(out),(y,0,1-x)),(x,0,1))
